rows.text: takes the low 14 bits of dword `+0x50` of `rcx` as an id (0xE00 becomes 0xDFF when dword `02EC3ECC` is 0 and stays 0xE00 otherwise), stores the first qword of what `002D7FA0(id)` returns at qword `+0x20`, then calls `002D7EE0(qword +0x50)` twice, storing the first qword of the first result at qword `+0x28` and dword `+8` of the second at dword `+0x30`
